# Toy CLI fixture provenance

`toy_cli.json` is a **synthetic, sanitized** response set. Its structure is derived from the upstream [DSH fake CLI at commit ae156ec](https://github.com/bilibili/toy/blob/ae156ecb3391dfb22bdd93d45d6b0067e1e5b723/dsh/packages/toy/test/fixtures/fake-toy.mjs), the upstream [DSH service adapter](https://github.com/bilibili/toy/blob/ae156ecb3391dfb22bdd93d45d6b0067e1e5b723/dsh/packages/toy/src/host/service.js), and **key shapes only** observed through read-only `whoami` and `mylist` calls on 2026-10-28. Both the locally installed v0.5.0 and a separately checksum-verified v0.6.4 binary returned `whoami` keys `name, uid` and `mylist` keys `list, pn, ps, total`. Listed items included `user_info` with `face, mid, name` and a `url` whose path was `/toy/<slug>/index.html`; the fixture mirrors that shape. No live values or preview URL were copied into this fixture.

The example ID, name, URLs, timestamps and status are invented test values. The shape is useful for unit tests, but local read calls do not verify hosted-runner authentication or write responses. Replace or supplement it with a separately sanitized fixture during the hosted-runner P0 check.
